title.narrative: Support to World Bank Group and IMF

description.narrative: Africa Fragility Initiative has sought to address the particular obstacles faced by fragile and conflict-affected countries trying to secure inward investment including by strengthening and simplifying regulatory frameworks and helping to build innovative supply chains involving local communities. Through DMFAS, developing countries offered a set of proven solutions to improve their capacity to manage public debt and consequently public resources through technical cooperation and advisory services. Irish Aid’s contribution to IFC Gender Partnership supports two areas of strategic alignment between IFC’s and Ireland’s objectives: women’s economic empowerment (insurance programmes) and the gender-climate nexus. The Umbrella Facility for Gender Equality (UFGE) remains the only WBG instrument to systematically and deliberately close gender gaps. Continuing with its four areas of focus - Regional Gender Innovation Labs, Private Sector Solutions, Data Analytics, and Research for Country Impact - the UFGE works at both the regional and country level to inspire, inform, facilitate, and support WBG efforts on gender equality and women’s economic empowerment. The Food Systems 2030 Trust Fund promotes new ways of doing business in creating sustainable food systems that integrate simultaneous pursuit of health for people, the planet, and the economy, including a one health approach that explicitly recognizes the interlinkage of human health, animal health, and the health of ecosystems.

The World Bank provides significant financial and technical support for developing countries in their efforts to eradicate poverty and achieve the SDGs. Ireland provides direct contributions to the World Bank through the Department of Finance. Irish Aid supplements this with support for a number of programmes, supporting the poorest countries and those in fragile situations in their efforts to develop the private sector with Africa Fragility Initiative, an IFC programme. This budget line also covers funding for UNCTAD's Debt Management and Financial Analysis System (DMFAS) Programme . In line with A Better World's priorities of gender equality, Irish Aid supports two Trust Funds - IFC's Gender Partnership that aims to advance women’s economic empowerment and inclusion; and IBRD Umbrella Facility for Gender Equality (UFGE) programme. Ireland joined the IBRD and IDA - Food systems 2030 Multi-Donor Trust Fund in 2022. Food Systems 2030 programme aim is to contribute to the creation of foundations for sustainable food systems that deliver improved livelihoods and safe, affordable and nutritious diets for all.
